what: Segments (head·body·tail) enter one by one along a hidden SVG rail at 220 units/second and then loop endlessly — each segment rotates to match the path tangent, and when heading right it flips vertically to keep the back up (flipped only offscreen). A dragon flying in the sky · a train · a procession walking hand in hand

options.spacing-phone: Gap between nodes at width 750 or less, default 45
options.flip: With off, it does not flip when going right either
options.[data-fx-part=rail]: a single path inside an svg with a viewBox — if set larger than the stage, the segments enter from off-screen
options.[data-fx-part=link]: Order from head to tail. Attach points are data-key="0.7 0.5"(Width and height share, default centered)

use: HeadBody…

from.where: shared.js makeDragon (dragon — original dragonDirection: hidden square rail of screen width+200rem, 26 segments head·body·kid·body×3·limb·body×15·limb·body×2·tail, PART_SPACING 96 (phone 45), SPEED 220, ease none, repeat -1 after entering, flips only off-screen). The site draws on a canvas and the part moves DOM segments

note: The original draws segment images on a canvas — the part moves the DOM so any element (image, SVG) can serve as a segment. Values, order and flip rules are the same
